svg.text: F1 Lap Analyser - five logo concepts
Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).

svg.title: F1 Lap Analyser - Ghost app icon

svg.text: You, and the ghost of your better lap one

svg.title: F1 Lap Analyser - Delta app icon

svg.text: The delta glyph; its hollow leans forward,
the time you have not found yet.

svg.title: F1 Lap Analyser - Pulse app icon

svg.text: A speed trace through one corner bends
around the apex and never touches it.

svg.title: F1 Lap Analyser - Slipped Square app icon

svg.text: The chequered flag with one square slipped
out of line: the hundredth you left.

svg.title: F1 Lap Analyser - Hundredth app icon

svg.text: The number the whole app exists to explain,
with its last digit in red.
